description: Finishes a recurring-job run started with start_open_design_job_run. It runs checks that need no browser on the target entry (missing local files, empty data-od-field elements, leftover placeholder text such as {{, TODO or Lorem ipsum, numbers found in no source, and the artifact viewer's size limits for the preview), settles the status (completed only without check errors; needs-review when the job has checks: required and the run had no browser), records outputs not made with their reasons (captures without a browser as skipped: no-browser), writes the run record to the job's run log, and returns a one-paragraph summary plus the remaining steps (commit or push the state branch, a PR, connector deliveries only for a completed run). Refuses, writing nothing, when runId isn't a started run of this job.

jobPath.description: The same job path passed to start_open_design_job_run.

notes.description: A sentence or two for the run record and summary: choices made without the person, anything odd.

notMade.description: Outputs the job asks for that this run did not make.

reason.description: Why, e.g. "no-browser", "no-artifact-tool", or a short sentence.

written.description: Workspace paths this run wrote: the entry, exports, snapshots.

status.description: completed when the design is done, needs-review when a person should look first, failed when it could not be made (e.g. a data pull failed).

name: finish_open_design_job_run
